title: Authorize exactly one normal reviewer password-reset request after successful exact-signature preflight
acceptance: the workflow requires a successful issue-comment run of the exact-signature reviewer reset preflight on the same exact current main
the successful authorization run must contain both the contract and production preflight jobs with conclusion success and run_attempt one
the immutable reset-request and read-only preflight source blobs are checked before any production request
the exact-signature read-only preflight is rerun immediately before the irreversible claim and must prove exact API Web auth-mail-worker parity with RESET_AUTHORIZED YES and PRODUCTION_MUTATION NONE
a fixed claim marker prevents any second reset from this reviewed exact-signature authority
only the normal password-reset request source is executed once; no reset link token recipient password TOTP secret cookie or credential is published
mail delivery remains delegated to the durable auth-mail outbox and worker architecture
